content: {"like": ["Colorization option is acceptable and well done overall", "Blu‑Ray transfers of the first three films look very impressive", "Bonus features such as commentary, feature‑ettes, interviews, stills gallery, and digital comic book are plentiful and enjoyable", "Creatures, especially in close‑ups, look great and are a wow moment", "The box set is well packaged and displayable on a shelf"], "dislike": ["Skin tones in the colorized versions can look a bit artificial", "The 7th Voyage of Sinbad transfer is inconsistent and not flawless, with some long shots appearing flat", "The film’s original source material limits the transfer quality, disappointing some fans who expected a newer look"]}
